notes: v2: 7 crossed alpha cards, 84 tris per clump, single card texture. Thin culms, nodes, arching leaves and awned ears are all present; huge improvement over the boxes.

defects.text: Spikelets are separate round orange beads with gaps, not a compact two-row ear; colour too saturated orange.
defects.fix: Draw a solid rachis body with elongated pale-gold overlapping spikelets and keels.

defects.text: Only one texture, so all cards in a clump repeat the same five culms.
defects.fix: Second texture with a different seed; alternate per card.

Box stalks replaced by thin culms.
